components.name: Command Button
components.description: A visible, low-noise command that is legible before hover.
components.css: .ds-command-button { padding: 4px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--hairline); border-radius: 0; background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); font: 500 12px/16px var(--font-ui); cursor: pointer; } .ds-command-button:hover { background: var(--grid-minor); } .ds-command-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Row Action
components.description: A contextual row-level verb that remains quiet until its record is active.
components.css: .ds-row-action { padding: 4px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--hairline); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink-muted); font: 500 12px/16px var(--font-ui); cursor: pointer; } .ds-row-action:hover { color: var(--ink); background: var(--paper); } .ds-row-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: In-place Field

narrative.overview: GeDe is a precision instrument for teams building a shared design model. The interface is precise, calm, instrumental, and quietly technical: graph paper is the working ground; opaque paper panels hold records; square geometry and hairline rules make interactions feel deliberate rather than decorative. The interface privileges the model over chrome. Tables are the durable record and the circle canvas is its spatial companion.
keyCharacteristics: Graph-paper ground with rectilinear, opaque working surfaces.
Forest green is the single chrome accent; dimension colors belong only to data.
Inter handles UI and content; JetBrains Mono marks the method’s symbols, tuples, ranks, and measurements.
Interaction is immediate; motion exists only to preserve spatial continuity.

rules.name: The One Chrome Hue Rule
rules.body: Use forest green for interface state and keep it out of the dimension-data palette.

rules.name: The Meaningful Mono Rule
rules.body: Use mono for model notation and measurement, never as a generic technical styling cue.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: A surface earns depth only when it temporarily floats above the model or must remain legible while pinned.

dos: Do treat the workspace as a precision instrument: use paper, hairlines, square corners, and low-noise hierarchy.
Do use forest green for chrome state and categorical color only for dimensions and relationships.
Do preserve in-place editing, keyboard operation, visible focus, and non-blocking inline recovery.
Do let the model provide visual interest: tuples, coverage, relationships, and data geometry outrank decoration.
donts: Don't turn GeDe into a dashboard of cards, summary metrics, or decorative charts.
Don't add gradients, rounded chrome, decorative shadows, or color used only for ornament.
Don't use mono for arbitrary labels or use dimension colors for generic interface emphasis.
Don't replace the live table/canvas model with a modal tutorial or separate form workflow.
